# KYHS Beauty

> Factory-direct manufacturer of false eyelashes, lash tools and private-label beauty accessories. Part of KEYUE HONGSHENG I/E CO., LTD. False lashes and accessories are beauty accessories, not formula cosmetics — no cosmetic registration required in most markets.

## Key facts

- Company: KEYUE HONGSHENG I/E CO., LTD. (KYHS)
- Business: False eyelashes (mink, faux mink, synthetic, 3D/5D), lash extension supplies, lash tools, makeup brushes, private-label packaging
- Model: OEM / ODM / private label, low MOQ, fast sampling, worldwide shipping
- Markets: Europe, North America, Australia and other international markets

## Compliance note

False eyelashes, tweezers, brushes and packaging are classified as beauty accessories, not formula cosmetics. They generally do not require CPNP registration (EU) or FDA MoCRA registration (US), unlike mascara, eyeshadow and skincare products.
